description:
[narrowed from route-edit-6a82e162] In repos/llm-resolver-vessel/src/index.ts, make a provider authentication failure mark the arm unwilling instead of leaving it permanently selectable. Today an anthropic 401 makes the completion fail over per call but records no cooldown, so claude-sonnet-5 and claude-haiku-4-5 keep winning Thompson selection and every draft they win is served by the failover walk instead of the selected model. In the completion error path, when a provider returns an authentication error (HTTP 401 or an authentication_error code), record a cooldown for that provider using the same cooldown state that inCooldown and inModelCooldown already read, so isModelWilling returns false for its arms and selectArm stops offering them. Change only that error path. Do not change selection scoring, priors, or any posterior.
